mechanism_claim: pullback_v_is_dry functions as a context flag whose sign-flip depends on ibd_entry_volume_ratio: dry-pullback + expanding entry volume = genuine accumulation resolving into continuation; dry-pullback + flat/shrinking entry volume = quiet distribution where the 'calm' is supply being absorbed off-exchange, and the B0 entry is a bull-trap that resolves into the ruin regime.
evidence_for: False_positive_ruin entity_8f0df3d38e had a 7-week -16.2% pullback with vol_ratio_5_20=1.24 (entry volume not expanded) and ruinated despite positive ma10/ma20 slopes; entity_ccc90a671f similar 7-week -14.4% pullback but vol_ratio_5_20=1.45 still ended ruin — consistent with dry-pullback without sufficient entry-volume confirmation. By contrast, winner entity_440e297253 had a 3-week -1.5% pullback paired with vol_ratio_5_20=1.588 (entry volume clearly expanded), and large_win entity_3adc078f01 had a 9-week -42.3% pullback with vol_ratio_5_20=1.14 plus mom_20=0.17.

Numeric contrast: ibd_entry_volume_ratio shows winners median 1.813 vs false_negatives 1.599 (standardized_delta -0.50), confirming entry-volume expansion is a discriminating axis that is missing in missed-winners, while pullback features alone (duration, pct) have weaker/mixed deltas, supporting that the interaction — not either term in isolation — carries the signal.
evidence_against: Winner entity_b00579f203 and entity_6618d3e80c succeeded with null pullback fields (no pullback setup at all), so the interaction only describes a subset regime and should not be applied as a hard requirement to every B0 candidate. Deep-pullback winner entity_3adc078f01 (-42.3%) shows that extreme pullback_pct can still resolve bullishly, implying pullback_v_is_dry may be mis-specified (or 'dry' is not just low-volume but also bounded-depth) — risk of encoding on a mislabeled binary.

Some false_positive_ruin cases (entity_4fdc3699fd, entity_3472243e0c, entity_84824e6a20, entity_b6bcccdf6a) have null pullback fields and high entry momentum/mom_20, indicating the dry-pullback×low-volume trap is not the only ruin pathway; the interaction only filters one failure mode.
falsifiable_predictions: Within current B0 picks, conditional ruin rate when pullback_v_is_dry=true AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio<1.3 should be ≥2× the ruin rate when pullback_v_is_dry=true AND ratio≥1.5; FPR parity when pullback_v_is_dry=false. Testable on holdout snapshots.

Applying an interaction veto (demote B0 picks satisfying dry-pullback ∧ low_entry_volume) to historical B0 outputs should reduce false_positive_ruin count by ≥30% while changing selected_winner count by <10%, i.e., the interaction acts as a precision lever without universe expansion.
policy_implications: Encode as a within-B0 modifier, not a new gate: compute interaction term only on tickers already in B0, so eligible universe is unchanged. Use a soft reweight (e.g., rank penalty or hard demote) keyed on (pullback_v_is_dry AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio below adaptive threshold such as 25th-percentile of recent winners).

Because the interaction filters rather than adds, it pairs naturally with the existing numeric-contrast finding that ibd_entry_volume_ratio alone carries a -0.50 standardized delta on false negatives — the interaction amplifies a feature already in the scoring stack rather than introducing a new axis, reducing overfitting risk on the 27-case archaeology sample.
